page.overview:
Who is Ankhmare?

Ankhmare was the Master Embalmer and Keeper of the Sacred Oils.

It was Ankhmare who found and hid copies of pages out of Nagash's master works, sowing the seeds that would eventually corrupt him. He and his fellows of the Mortuary Cult, Hierophant Khenteka and Nebamun, were accompanied by two high priests and twelve priests from the fourteen Temples of the Old Gods in Khemri.
